service.name: Acoustic duo and trio
service.serviceType: Acoustic duo and trio for cocktail hours, dinner parties, patios and welcome drinks
service.description: Voice and guitar, guitar and upright bass, or the trio joining all three musicians, playing singer-songwriter and folk-rock covers at conversation volume for cocktail hours, dinner parties and receptions across Denver and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.a: About as loud as the conversation around it. Guests can tell it's live music from across the venue, and the people at the nearest table still talk without leaning in. Two or three acoustic musicians set the level to the space, and they stay at that level all night.

faqs.q: How long can the duo play?
faqs.a: Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with 15 to 20 minutes between them, and music keeps playing through the breaks. A single hour is a real booking, and so is arrival through dessert. If the night runs long, another half hour is easy to add on the night.

faqs.q: How much space and power does it need?
faqs.a: A duo sets up in a corner of about 8 by 6 feet on one circuit, and the trio needs a little more. Sound support that's the right size for the venue comes with the booking.

faqs.q: Can the acoustic duo play outside?
faqs.a: Yes, and patios are its regular work. The sound support is what lets two musicians fill a garden, and the duo needs a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it. Colorado evenings cool fast, so we agree a plan for moving indoors with you ahead of time.
